summary: Iteration 3 — Premium UI/UX redesign regression verification (frontend-only as requested). All 50 critical testIDs across login, register entry, home dashboard, 5-tab bottom nav, games, chat, leaderboard, profile, tap challenge, missions, spin, quiz, daily reward, and logout flow verified end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844) against the public preview URL. 0 JS console errors. Gradient hero cards, soft-shadow BrutalCard, GradientCard, AnimatedEntrance fade+slide, and Skeleton loaders all behave correctly. NO regressions detected from the redesign.

issues: AnimatedEntrance fade-in (~350ms+ staggered delays) means a screenshot taken immediately after navigation may still show below-fold sections (stats, daily-cta, quick-play grid) mid-fade. After ~1.2s everything renders correctly with rich gradients and good contrast. Not a bug — just a note for testing agents to wait ~1.5s before screenshotting home.

react_native_issues.issue: Carried over from iter 2: deprecated style warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image.style.resizeMode) likely still present at web-preview bundle level but did NOT produce any console.error in this run. Cosmetic only.

action_items: No required fixes. UI redesign is regression-free across all listed flows.
Optional: address deprecated style props for cleaner bundler output (carry-over).
critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx, (tabs)/index.tsx and friends correctly preserve every legacy testID — refactor was non-breaking.
AnimatedEntrance wraps top-level sections (delay 50/200/350ms) — keep delays modest (<500ms) to avoid feeling sluggish on slower devices; current values are fine.

GradientCard / BrutalCard rely on layered shadows + LinearGradient — render correctly on web preview; contrast on level-card (white text on purple→pink gradient) is good (verified visually in full-page screenshot).
Skeleton loaders on chat/leaderboard show very briefly (<1s) then real data — verified chat skeleton resolves to message list and leaderboard skeleton resolves to podium+rows.
Profile gradient header, 6 stat cards (stat-total-xp/level/coins/streak/games/best-tap), profile-edit toggle, and profile-logout all functional. Logout cleanly returns to login screen.
Leaderboard rows continue to render rank≥4 via leaderboard-row-N (got 7 rows for the all-time window with current seed data); ranks 1–3 in the podium — by design (matches iter 2 note).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (50/50 testID checks + 0 console errors across login → home → all 5 tabs → tap/missions/spin/quiz/daily → logout)
